shipping068.holding: Carrier lost; replacement is funded and born only at the existing home yard.

stages.body: Wren's packet names a baseline cut into this outer landing stone. Paired with ordinary outward work, charting it fixes the first meridian leg without a duplicate fee. Its back-sight points to a farther group across open water.

choices.text: Plot the farther bearing and press on
choices.tradeoff: Reveals only the earned second bearing. Pushing on spends your own voyage reserves; no stores or coins are granted.

choices.text: Log the single-leg sight and turn home
choices.tradeoff: Preserves return fuel and rations with a dated partial sight; leaves the second baseline unsurveyed.

stages.nextAction: Chart the first distant landing (remote_13_survey) and weigh fuel, food and kits before pushing on.
stages.title: Chart the Outer Range Mark

stages.body: The second landing holds the companion cairn. A full survey reconciles drift between both outer groups and fixes a deep-sea approach line. Your party works from its own hold; the cairn yields bearings, not cargo.

choices.text: Record the paired outer meridian survey
choices.tradeoff: Completes the two-group meridian record. Return travel still depends on your remaining fuel and food.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey the second distant landing (remote_16_survey) to complete the paired sight.
stages.title: Survey the Farther Baseline

stages.body: At Reedwater Floats, Wren reviews your logbook. A completed two-group survey can enter the public register or stay in your private book; a single-leg return is filed honestly as a dated sight.

choices.text: Enter the two-group meridian in Wren's public register
choices.tradeoff: Reed +4, Compact -2, Wren +7. Unlocks one later funded outer passage when stocks and treasury allow.

choices.text: Keep the completed meridian in your private log
choices.tradeoff: Wren -3, Tobin +5. Retains private route notes for one later brokered passage at Brass Haven; no free coins.

choices.text: File the dated single-leg sight with Wren
choices.tradeoff: Reed +2, Wren +3. Honest partial return; records the first bearing without claiming the farther baseline.

stages.nextAction: Return to Reedwater Floats with service access and settle how the sight is entered.
stages.title: Settle the Meridian Register

catalog.summary: Wren holds an unfinished outer meridian sight. Chart the first mark on a funded outward run, check reserves before the second group, and settle the baseline.
catalog.title: The Broken Meridian

stages.body: Wren lays a salt-stained book beside a newer harbor register. Its staff marks appear inverted, but correcting them at a desk would only replace one guess with another. Chart the actual pans before taking the comparison into the marsh.

choices.text: Copy the charted salt-staff marks
choices.tradeoff: Earn the marsh comparison bearing. This records your chart; it grants no further survey or cargo.

stages.nextAction: Chart the Verdigris Salt Pans and read the reversed staff marks.
stages.title: Read the Salt Staff

stages.body: The marsh scales preserve the other half of the tide book's notation. A full survey can distinguish a reversed reference from a changed tide. The resulting correction belongs in a register only after you decide who receives it.

choices.text: Record the matched marsh scales
choices.tradeoff: The comparison is recorded. Return to Wren to choose the register; no freight has been issued.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey Reed Marsh Landing and compare its scales with the salt staff.
stages.title: Match the Marsh Scales

stages.body: The two measured scales explain the inversion. Wren can publish the correction, or lodge a bonded copy through Tobin's Compact factors. Either decision settles the book here and unlocks one finite freight opportunity; carrying that freight is separate work.

consequences.reason: Tide correction entered in the public register
Returned the measured public tide correction

choices.text: Enter the correction in Wren's public register
choices.tradeoff: Reed +4, Compact -2, Wren +6. Unlocks one funded Reedwater-to-Silt Hollow passage for four real repair kits, subject to stocks, treasury and a route.

consequences.reason: Tide correction withheld from the public register
Entrusted the measured tide correction to his factors

choices.text: Lodge the correction in Tobin's bonded register
choices.tradeoff: Compact +4, Reed -2, Tobin +6, Wren -3. Unlocks one funded Brass-to-Silt Hollow passage for four real repair kits, subject to stocks, treasury and a route.

stages.nextAction: Return to Wren at Reedwater Floats and choose the public or bonded register.
stages.title: Choose the Tide Register

catalog.summary: Wren has a tide book whose salt-staff marks run backwards. Compare the real pans and marsh before choosing a public or bonded register.
catalog.title: The Inverted Tide Book

stages.body: Tobin puts a bundle of unpaid delivery slips on the quay. Sawtooth has buyers and a usable mill, but its timber reserve is thin. Five bundles from your own hold will keep the next work order possible.

choices.text: Unload 5 timber at the mill
choices.tradeoff: Your cargo becomes mill stock; the mill owes its next opening to you.

stages.nextAction: Deliver timber from your own hold to Sawtooth Mill.
stages.title: Feed the Mill

stages.body: A mill hand remembers ironwood above the shoal, where ordinary logging boats turn back. The buyers need sound bearings before they commit another convoy. Chart the stand; no one is paying for a rumor.

choices.text: Show Tobin the coastal chart
choices.tradeoff: A charted stand can be contracted; an unproven rumor cannot.

stages.nextAction: Chart the Sawtooth Ironwood Stand so buyers believe it exists.
stages.title: Prove the Stand

stages.body: Two factors arrive with competing manifests. Choose the first recipient and Tobin will post one finite, funded timber passage at Sawtooth, paid by its treasury. The other faction will remember being passed over.

consequences.reason: Ironwood first call to Compact yards
Forge buyers queued behind the Compact

choices.text: Compact yards get first call
choices.tradeoff: One funded Sawtooth timber passage to Brass Haven; Compact standing rises and Forge standing falls.

consequences.reason: Ironwood first call to Forge yards
Compact buyers queued behind the Forge

choices.text: Forge yards get first call
choices.tradeoff: One funded Sawtooth timber passage to Anvil Dock; Forge standing rises and Compact standing falls.

stages.nextAction: Return to Brass Haven and choose whose yards the ironwood feeds first.
stages.title: Pick a Buyer

catalog.summary: Tobin Hale can place Sawtooth ironwood with two rival buyers, if someone proves the stand and keeps the mill fed.
catalog.title: Ironwood for the Mill

stages.body: Tobin's last sounding sheet begins at the west marker. Its figures were never reconciled with the other two records. A full survey earns the next bearing; accepting the sheet proves no recovery.

choices.text: Record the surveyed west marker
choices.tradeoff: The west sounding is recorded and the crown-log bearing is earned.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey the Longglass west marker.
stages.title: Survey the West Marker

stages.body: The crown log supplies the missing reference for the west marker. Its last entry points toward the south wreck, but the entry alone cannot replace a survey there.

choices.text: Record the surveyed crown log
choices.tradeoff: The crown sounding is recorded and the south-wreck bearing is earned.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey the Longglass crown log.
stages.title: Survey the Crown Log

stages.body: The third survey completes the sounding record and identifies the existing Longglass abandoned cache. Before depletion that source held one engine assembly, eight copper, twelve repair kits and sixteen timber. These are finite existing stocks; this lead supplies no replacements.

choices.text: Record the surveyed south wreck
choices.tradeoff: Earn the actual cache bearing. Survey and paid recovery still use their normal requirements.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey the Longglass south wreck.
stages.title: Survey the South Wreck

stages.body: A completed paid load from this source while this stage is active can support your recovery record. Depletion by other salvors proves no player work. An already exhausted, surveyed and seeded source can instead receive an honest empty-cache record. Missing stock records are not evidence of exhaustion.

choices.text: Take the paid recovery record to Wren
choices.tradeoff: Choose Reedwater Floats for the actual turn-in. No standing or trust changes until you register there with service access.

choices.text: Take the paid recovery record to Cass
choices.tradeoff: Choose Rust Anchorage for the actual turn-in. Normal standing or paid safe conduct is still required.

choices.text: Verify exhaustion and take the empty-cache record to Wren
choices.tradeoff: Requires all three soundings and an actually surveyed, seeded, empty cache. Claims no paid recovery; turn in at Reedwater with service access.

choices.text: Verify exhaustion and take the empty-cache record to Cass
choices.tradeoff: Requires all three soundings and an actually surveyed, seeded, empty cache. Claims no paid recovery; normal Rust access remains required.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey the actual Longglass cache. Complete a paid recovery load there, or explicitly record a verified exhausted source, then choose a harbor register.
stages.title: Check the Actual Cache

stages.body: Wren will enter what your record actually supports: a completed paid recovery load or a verified exhausted cache. Registering the soundings creates no machinery, stores or payment.

consequences.reason: Longglass soundings entered in Wren's register
Returned an honest Longglass sounding record

choices.text: Enter the last soundings in Wren's public register
choices.tradeoff: Reed +4, Raiders -3, Wren +6. The record preserves whether you completed paid recovery or verified exhaustion.

stages.nextAction: Turn in the sounding record to Wren at Reedwater Floats with normal service access.
stages.title: Register with Wren

stages.body: Cass accepts the same honest distinction between completed paid work and an exhausted source. Her register remains inside Rust's normal harbor permissions. The standing earned here cannot pay for or precede your access.

consequences.reason: Registered the last soundings with Cass
Longglass soundings withheld from the public register
Returned an honest Longglass sounding record

choices.text: Enter the last soundings in Cass's register
choices.tradeoff: Raiders +4, Reed -3, Cass +6, applied only after this permitted Rust turn-in. No harbor access or recovered goods are granted.

stages.nextAction: Turn in the sounding record to Cass at Rust Anchorage using normal standing or paid safe conduct.
stages.title: Register with Cass

catalog.summary: Tobin has three unfinished Longglass soundings. Survey their actual sites, check the finite cache honestly, then register the record with Wren or Cass.
catalog.title: The Last Soundings

stages.body: The launch Low Lantern vanished after Wren sent it to check an old storm bearing. Her last bottle post names a rock, not a harbor. A proper chart may explain why the crew changed course.

choices.text: Share the chart with Wren's keepers
choices.tradeoff: The Commune gains the route too; Wren owes you trust, but the wreck field will not stay yours alone.

choices.text: Keep the chart secret
choices.tradeoff: No one else learns the bearing; no harbor owes you anything for it either.

stages.nextAction: Chart the Middle Sea Chart Rock, then decide who learns what it says.
stages.title: Read the Chart Rock

stages.body: The rock's crossed bearings point east to Shatter Wreck Field. Wren's bottle-post marks match the broken moorings there: Low Lantern changed course to search for shelter. A full survey can read the remaining tags and locate what the storm left behind.

choices.text: Mark the field in your journal
choices.tradeoff: Earn the Rust Salvage Anchorage bearing. Recovery at surveyed Shatter is already possible if the waters, spare crew, kits and hold allow it; the claim is still to make.

stages.nextAction: Chart, then fully survey Shatter Wreck Field. Check its finite recovery before deciding whether to return or investigate the anchorage.
stages.title: Survey the Wreck Field

stages.body: The survey tags place Low Lantern's last shelter at Rust Salvage Anchorage; its bearing is yours to investigate or leave for another voyage. Wren can now register Shatter's field publicly, or you can keep it private. Recovery was available after your survey: neither choice takes cargo already aboard. A charter grants access to a paid yard, not a free hull, staffed workshop or renewable salvage.

consequences.reason: Wreck field claimed under Commune notice

choices.text: Open the field to Commune salvors
choices.tradeoff: Reed standing +4; Reef standing -3. Nearby Commune traders may spend their own kits to lift the field's remaining finite materials. Opens paid cooperative yard access; keeps everything you already recovered.

choices.text: Stake an exclusive salvage claim
choices.tradeoff: Wren trust -4. No public Commune recovery; a private salvage yard can be paid for only at a Reef harbor with legal access. Keeps everything you already recovered.

stages.nextAction: Return to Reedwater Floats and settle who may work the field.
stages.title: Choose a Claim

catalog.summary: Sister Wren's chart-keepers want the bottle-post rock read properly; what you do with its secret is yours.
catalog.title: The Middle Sea Chart

stages.body: Mara recognizes the workshop bell in your sketch. She left the Cinder works before a failed evacuation, and knows which foundations survived. Survey the ruin before she risks other workers there.

choices.text: Bring Mara the full survey
choices.tradeoff: Mara can judge the forge bed honestly; materials are still on you.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey the Cinder Crown Workshop Ruin.
stages.title: Survey the Ruin

stages.body: The surviving forge bed is sound. Mara will not send a party with empty repair racks: four kits must reach Anvil as actual stock. Your survey and delivery are steps toward a charter, not an instant building.

choices.text: Unload 4 repair kits for the forge party
choices.tradeoff: Your kits become yard stock for the landing; they are not coming back as cargo.

stages.nextAction: Deliver repair kits from your hold at Anvil Dock for the shore party.
stages.title: Stock the Forge

stages.body: The ore bearing completes the picture. Backing Mara grants the right to open your own paid workshop business later, with hired staff and operating capital. Keeping the seam private opens a finite ore passage instead; Mara receives no charter.

consequences.reason: Proved the seam for her charter

choices.text: Back Mara's harbor workshop charter
choices.tradeoff: Workshop charter right opens. Setup still needs your coins, materials, workers and operating capital.

choices.text: Keep the seam chart for your own fleet
choices.tradeoff: A funded private ore passage opens at Cinder Quay. The workshop charter stays closed; Mara loses trust.

stages.nextAction: Chart the Cinder Crown Ore Seam that would feed a revived forge.
stages.title: Prove the Seam

catalog.summary: Mara Voss built on the Cinder Crown years ago; a surveyed ruin, real materials and a guarded landing could wake it.
catalog.title: The Cold Workshop

stages.body: Cass has a list of skippers who paid the Kelpback toll twice and still lost their cargo. She wants a confirmed sighting before naming the collection fleet. Watch the shore without spending your crews on an unproven landing.

choices.text: Report the sighting to Cass
choices.tradeoff: Cass can name the toll fleet; the camp still has to be dealt with.

stages.nextAction: Sight the Kelpback Toll Camp from the water.
stages.title: Find the Camp

stages.body: The collector is the real company marked patrol-0. Its hulls, wages and replacements belong to this coast. A recorded defeat breaks this particular toll claim even if the company later finds money for another boat.

choices.text: Claim the broken toll
choices.tradeoff: The lane is open by force; who benefits is the next decision.

stages.nextAction: Destroy or disable the named raider toll fleet (patrol-0).
stages.title: Break the Toll

stages.body: The camp papers contain bearings through the shoal. Publishing them opens a funded public chart-courier passage; sharing them only with Cass opens private courier work to Rust. Neither choice creates free cargo or a free payment.

choices.text: Publish the shoal cut
choices.tradeoff: A funded public chart-courier passage opens at Reedwater Floats; Reed standing rises and Raiders fall.

choices.text: Keep the cut uncharted
choices.tradeoff: A funded private courier passage to Rust opens at Brass Haven; Cass gains trust and Reed standing falls.

stages.nextAction: Chart the Kelpback Shoal Cut, then decide who may use it.
stages.title: Open or Keep the Cut

catalog.summary: Cass Rye knows who collects at the Kelpback toll camp, and what breaking or buying that toll would open.
catalog.title: The Toll Camp

stages.body: Above the frontier landing, two iron lantern cages mark a dogleg channel inside the surf. Charting the headland shows how local pilots cross the bar at night. The harbor remains under its saved local faction and service rules.

choices.text: Record the two-lantern bar alignment
choices.tradeoff: Identifies the night alignment into the anchorage. Harbor entry and trade still use normal local permissions.

stages.nextAction: Chart the frontier survey landing (frontier_06_survey) to read the paired bar lanterns.
stages.title: Chart the Two-Lantern Headland

stages.body: The frontier harbor's lantern frames and tide chains need four repair kits from your hold. Unloading them into real harbor stock proves your company can sustain a distant berth.

choices.text: Unload 4 repair kits into the frontier harbor's stock
choices.tradeoff: Moves 4 supplies from your hold into harbor stock. Requires service access; pays no instant coin bounty.

stages.nextAction: Dock at the frontier harbor (frontier_06_harbor_01) with service access and unload 4 repair kits.
stages.title: Supply the Frontier Berth

stages.body: With the kits in the storehouse and the bar charted, the local desk and Tobin's factors await your terms: publish the night-channel bearings openly, or register a bonded berth arrangement.

choices.text: Publish the two-lantern night bearings openly
choices.tradeoff: Reed +4, Wren +5, Compact -2. Shares the frontier approach intelligence; grants no free port or hull.

consequences.reason: Kept bar alignment in bonded books

choices.text: Register a bonded berth arrangement with Tobin
choices.tradeoff: Compact +4, Tobin +6, Reed -2. Records a client relationship for later funded frontier freight; local sovereignty stays unchanged.

stages.nextAction: At the frontier harbor (frontier_06_harbor_01), publish the bar alignment or bind it to the local desk.
stages.title: Choose the Anchorage Arrangement

catalog.summary: Tobin Hale reports a two-lantern bar signal at a distant frontier harbor. Chart the headland, deliver real repair kits into harbor stock, and settle the channel notes.
catalog.title: The Two-Lantern Anchorage

stages.body: Mara's ledger places an unfinished workboat frame above a remote shingle landing. A full survey checks whether the ways still hold its documented fittings or were stripped. Surveying spawns no free hull or locker parts.

choices.text: Verify the slipway frame against Mara's manifest
choices.tradeoff: Opens the recovery choice here. Actual part or lot extraction requires separate paid salvage recovery and hold space.

stages.nextAction: Fully survey the outer slipway landing (remote_28_survey).
stages.title: Survey the Stranded Slipway

stages.body: The stranded frame's remaining stock is finite under one permanent source identity. Taking fittings or lots requires a paid recovery transaction and carrier space. If the source is exhausted or too heavy for safe return, log that honestly.

choices.text: Record completed paid recovery from the workboat source
choices.tradeoff: Requires an actual completed recovery receipt from the seeded source. Grants no extra parts or coins.

choices.text: Leave the frame untouched to preserve return margin
choices.tradeoff: Keeps hold and crew reserves for the ocean return. Unstripped stock remains finite at the landing.

choices.text: Verify and log an already exhausted slipway source
choices.tradeoff: Requires a surveyed, seeded source with zero remaining stock. Never refills a depleted landing.

stages.nextAction: Complete paid recovery from the seeded workboat source, verify an exhausted slipway, or keep your hold clear for return.
stages.title: Weigh Recovery Against Reserves

stages.body: At Anvil Dock, Mara compares your deck log with her yard sheet. Closing the record either releases the salvage provenance to Forge shipwrights or keeps the surveyed build notes with your company.

choices.text: Sign the slipway provenance into Mara's Forge register
choices.tradeoff: Forge +4, Raiders -2, Mara +6. Keeps what you physically recovered; grants no free equipment.

choices.text: Keep the surveyed framing notes in your company file
choices.tradeoff: Mara -3, Cass +5. Preserves private salvage notes for Rust contacts without minting hulls, parts or coins.

stages.nextAction: Return to Anvil Dock with service access and close the keel record with Mara.
stages.title: Settle the Slipway Ledger

catalog.summary: Mara Voss holds the slipway ledger for a workboat frame left on an outer shore. Survey the landing, weigh paid recovery against return margin, and close the record.
catalog.title: The Unfinished Keel
